reason: The designation of the Assistant Secretaries and the Solicitor of Labor to act as Secretary of Labor was ended in full by Executive Order 13245, section 4, which states "Executive Order 10513 of January 19, 1954, is hereby revoked." EO 13245 was signed on 2001-12-18 (66 FR 66268, published 2001-12-21) and contains no deferred effective date, so the first end is 2001-12-18. No held source shows an earlier end.
